## Publish gate report

**Going out:** a paid creator post promoting Pebblebrook's Assam, channel and timing not specified.

**Checks**
- **Claims:** Pass. "Packed by hand in Bristol" is on the policy list. The Assam mention and the "afternoon reset" are personal framing, not claims.
- **Regulated claims:** Pass. There are no health, money, environmental or price claims. "Selfcare" is only a hashtag and makes no promise.
- **House style:** Pass. The policy defines no voice words or banned list, so I only checked for AI tells and found none. The seven-hashtag pile is a mild style issue, not a blocker.
- **Disclosure:** **Fail.** The only label is `#ad`, placed last in a block of six other hashtags. Disclosure has to come before the reader engages, in plain words, and a hashtag buried in a pile doesn't count. This is a paid partnership, so the post would not be clearly labelled for UK audiences.

**Fixed (suggested rewrite)**
- Added a clear label at the very start and used the platform's paid-partnership tool.
- Moved `#ad` out of the end of the hashtag block, since the opening label now carries the disclosure.

> **Ad | Paid partnership with Pebblebrook Tea Co.**
> My afternoon reset is a pot of Pebblebrook's Assam and ten minutes away from my phone. Their tins are packed by hand in Bristol, which I love. #tea #teatime #bristol #slowliving #assam #selfcare

**Needs a decision**
- Confirm the creator will switch on the platform's branded-content or paid-partnership toggle. My suggested answer is yes, in addition to the written label.
- The policy names no approver for creator posts. Please tell me who signs off, and give an explicit yes to the exact revised text above.

**Approver:** not named in the policy, so you (the user) need to approve this exact final content. I have not recorded any approval, and it can't go out until you do.

{"issues": [{"quote": "My afternoon reset is a pot of Pebblebrook's Assam", "type": "missing_disclosure"}], "publish": false}
